source: code values observed in the NAVWAR LRAE (June 2025 release), NAVSEA Enterprise LRAE (December 2025), FPDS feeds and the PAE Mission Systems site
rule: a parser classifies any observed code by the first matching family, then resolves it through the alias table in organization_seed.json; unknown codes are stored as unverified nodes and queued for review

families.era: PEO and PAE (codes unchanged so far)
families.parent_hint: PEO named on the office's tear sheet or official page; PEO C4I for PMW 1xx/7xx, PEO Digital for PMW 2xx/205, PEO MLB for PMW 22x-25x, 444
where_seen: LRAE Associated Program or Requirement Office
families.normalize: strip hyphens and spaces: PMW-160, PMW 160, PMW160 -> PMW 160; PMW/A-170 -> PMW/A 170; PMA/PMW-101 -> PMA/PMW 101

families.parent_hint: a NAVSEA PEO (e.g. PEO Submarines for PMS 485 per the 2019 J&A); now PAE Maritime / Undersea / Mission Systems by portfolio
